privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
runs: Learn how Maple Furnishers collects, protects, and responsibly uses your information.
Your information is treated with care and responsibility.
Clear communication about how your data is used.
At Maple Furnishers, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the information you share with us.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data when you interact with our website, place an order, or communicate with us.
By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described below.
We do not sell or trade your personal information.
We take reasonable measures to protect your information from misuse or unauthorised access.
Our website may use cookies to improve browsing experience and analyse traffic.
We may contact you via phone calls, SMS, or email regarding orders and updates.
We retain information only for operational, legal, and customer service purposes.
Third-party marketplace purchases may also be governed by their respective privacy policies.
You may request access, updates, or communication preferences regarding your information.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected on this page.

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
runs: Made-to-order furniture, crafted with care. Please review our policy terms below.
Every Maple piece is manufactured only after order confirmation.
Claims are reviewed and approved after assessment by Maple Furnishers.
Issues should be reported within 24–48 hours of delivery.
All Maple Furnishers products are custom-built on order.
Due to the personalised nature of our furniture, we follow a strict no-return and no-refund policy, except under specific conditions outlined below.
Orders can be cancelled only before production begins
Once production has started, cancellations are not permitted
Approved cancellations, if any, will be processed after deduction of applicable costs
Returns or replacements are accepted only in the following cases:
No other reasons, including change of mind, aesthetic preference, or minor variation, will be accepted.
Notify us within 24–48 hours of delivery
Share clear photos/videos highlighting the issue
Delayed reporting may result in rejection of the claim.
All claims are subject to inspection and approval by Maple Furnishers.
The company reserves the sole right to determine whether a product qualifies as defective.
Based on evaluation, we may offer:
Refunds are not standard practice and are issued only in exceptional cases.
The following are not considered defects and are not eligible for return or refund:
Natural wood grains, texture, or colour variations
Fabric tone variations due to lighting or screen differences
Seasonal expansion or contraction of wood
Damage due to misuse, improper handling, or environmental exposure

shipping-policy.title: Shipping
runs: Made-to-order furniture, crafted with care. Please review our shipping processes and terms below.
All Maple Furnishers products are crafted on order.
Each piece enters production only after order confirmation and payment. This allows us to maintain complete control over quality, materials, and finish.
As every product is made-to-order, delivery timelines vary based on: Product type and complexity, level of customisation, and production load.
Note: Timelines shared at the time of purchase are indicative, not guaranteed. We prioritise craftsmanship over speed and we keep you informed through the process.
Shipping is chargeable and not included in product prices
Charges are calculated based on product size, weight, and delivery location
Final shipping cost will be communicated before order confirmation
Deliveries are handled through trusted logistics partners and in-house coordination where applicable.
The delivery team will contact you prior to dispatch or delivery. Customers must ensure availability to receive the product at the scheduled time.
Before delivery, please ensure: Clear access paths (doorways, lifts, staircases), adequate space for movement and placement, and necessary permissions for entry, if applicable.
Maple Furnishers is not responsible for delivery delays or additional costs arising due to site constraints.
Installation is chargeable and may vary based on product and location
Availability of installation depends on service coverage
Installation, where applicable, is scheduled separately from delivery
While we aim to deliver within committed timelines, delays may occur due to: Logistics disruptions, weather conditions, regional restrictions, and supply chain dependencies.
Such delays do not qualify for cancellation or compensation.
At the time of delivery, customers are required to: Inspect the product for visible damage or defects, and confirm receipt only after basic verification.
Once the product is accepted, responsibility transfers to the customer. Delayed reporting of issues may result in rejection of claims. Delay claims must be registered within 24-48 hours.
For orders with multiple products, items may be delivered separately, depending on production timelines.
No guarantee of a single consolidated delivery.
